cd /workspace/t && cat > t3.py <<'EOF'
import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v,envelope,stream,crypto,datagram,trace
from h import run
def T(events,**kw): return run({"traces":[trace(events,**kw)]})['traces'][0]
def P(r): print(json.dumps(r['packets'])); print('closed',json.dumps(r['closed']),'epochs',json.dumps(r['epochs']),'key_epoch',r['key_epoch'],'keys',r['keys'])

# 1. no key -> NO_KEY
r=T([datagram(envelope('A',0,b'\x01'),auth=[0])]); print('1 nokey:'); P(r)
# 2. auth null
r=T([{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,b'\x01'),auth=[None])]); print('2 authnull:'); P(r)
# 3. auth generation 1 when current 0 -> allowed, advances epoch, parity must match phase
r=T([{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,b'\x01',phase=1),auth=[1])]); print('3 gen1 phase1:'); P(r)
# 4. auth generation 1 with phase 0 -> parity mismatch AUTH
r=T([{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,b'\x01',phase=0),auth=[1])]); print('4 gen1 phase0:'); P(r)
# 5. auth generation 2 (current 0) -> AUTH (out of window)
r=T([{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,b'\x01',phase=0),auth=[2])]); print('5 gen2:'); P(r)
# 6. epoch advance then old epoch packet reordered
evs=[{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',5,b'\x01',phase=0),auth=[0]),
     datagram(envelope('A',7,b'\x01',phase=1),auth=[1]),
     datagram(envelope('A',6,b'\x01',phase=0),auth=[0])]
r=T(evs); print('6 reorder:'); P(r); print(' received',r['received'])
# 7. KEY_UPDATE_ERROR: epoch1 pn below epoch0 max
evs=[{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',9,b'\x01',phase=0),auth=[0]),
     datagram(envelope('A',5,b'\x01',phase=1),auth=[1])]
r=T(evs); print('7 keyupdate:'); P(r)
# 8. after close, well-framed packets CLOSED, key events no effect
evs=[{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,bytes([0x1d])+v(0)+v(0),phase=0),auth=[0]),
     {'keys':['I','H']},
     datagram(envelope('A',1,b'\x01',phase=0),auth=[0]),
     datagram(envelope('I',0,b'\x01'),auth=[0])]
r=T(evs); print('8 closed:'); P(r); print(' keys',r['keys'])
EOF
python3 t3.py
